'''Tazonthe Ghon''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Pilgrims|Pilgrim]] who lived on [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] illegally during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
A [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Gender/Legends|male]], Tazonthe Ghon was the son of [[Poronth Ghon]]. He, along with his father, was one of many [[Pilgrims]] who followed [[Matriarch/Legends|Matriarch]] [[Kolovish]] to the planet [[Tython/Legends|Tython]] in the aftermath of the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] of [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. Assisting in the establishment of [[Kalikori village]], Ghon was bereaved when he learned that his father had been killed and eaten by a band of [[Flesh Raider]]s in the [[Tythos Ridge]].<ref name="TOR" />
